description: The ood.* rename of the six OOD vehicle blueprint IDs to the neutral vehicle.ood.* namespace. This is the bundled, generator-facing subset of the release rename map: exactly the two maps build_records.py consumes, so the published records are reproducible from this repository alone. The route XMLs under routes/ and routes/MANIFEST.tsv were rewritten from the same maps.
notes_for_consumers: blueprint_id_map: OLD vendor blueprint id -> released vehicle.ood.* id. Applied by build_records.py to the `agent_type` column AFTER OOD-collision attribution has run, because the collision messages in the raw result JSONs carry the OLD ids.

token_map: OLD on-disk prop token -> released token. Applied to `variant` to produce `prop`; the verbatim on-disk token is preserved as `prop_raw`, which is the join key back to the raw result tree and to the frozen analysis CSVs.
Only `sedane`->`sedan` and `amv`->`armoredvan` actually change a token; the other four are identity entries and are listed for completeness.
Walkers and static props were already generic and are NOT renamed.
